name: Hu tieu with pate
summary: Breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4 is hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice the provincial tourism portal calls local. The 9 June 2021 article describes that slice as a house chả of pig-head skin, pork fat, lean pork, and pepper, and says the counter has made it for more than 20 years. Vietnam Tourism describes a dinner bowl of the same noodle with pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. Keep both plates. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Ben Tre town. The breakfast slice is the portal’s plate. The dinner bowl is Vietnam Tourism’s plate. They are not the same bowl.
texture: The 9 June 2021 article calls the slice dai giòn and beo béo: chewy, crisp at the edge, and rich. That is that counter’s slice, not the quail-egg bowl.
howToEat: Eat the pâté slice at breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4. Do not fold it into the dinner bowl.

Vietnam Tourism’s dinner bowl is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. The 9 June 2021 article also names wonton, seafood, and pork-and-bone bowls at the same counter. Those are not the pâté bowl.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: Đường 30 Tháng 4 for the breakfast slice. Vietnam Tourism does not name a street for the dinner bowl. The neighbor bowl is hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho.
seoTitle: Hu tieu with pate in Ben Tre — two plates
seoDescription: Breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4 is hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice. Vietnam Tourism’s dinner bowl adds pork, shrimp, and a quail egg. The price is check on arrival.
